page_note: Page entirely concerns the doctrine of metarrismos (transmigration/transformation) and παίδευσις (training) as applied to catechumens and sinners. This is Manichaean ecclesial doctrine wrapped in dialogue frame, with a παίδευσις analogy (parents training sons with strikes but not killing) applied as hortatory illustration of how catechumens are disciplined. No cosmological substrate visible — teaching purity 0.000. 90.6% damage. Editorial fatigue confirmed: dialogue frame in first half gives way to ecclesial+hortatory material in second half. Page is wholly editorial.
